explanation.text: **The Logic:** Factor investing exploits persistent systematic drivers of return. **The Trap:** Dividend yield is one possible factor but not the only one. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same framework in XV, X-A. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Use multi-factor blends to smooth out single-factor cyclicality.
